Connected a ready crop with farmers harvesting it.

Pongal and Baisakhi connections remained uncertain; not corrected later.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting harvest festivals with the season and crop being celebrated. Kavya correctly described that farmers cut a crop when it is ready, and they shared examples about Diwali. They mixed up whether Pongal and Baisakhi have fixed harvest connections, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use simple cards to match each festival with its crop and season.
